text:
maya: Heads-up — hit a KV-cache OOM on prod-3 during a ~40k-token session. Observed repeated slab thrashing + occupancy runaway. stack traces attached in logs below.

maya: quick log snippet:
```
oom: alloc failed slab_id=5 wanted=204800 available=102400
evict: tried_pages=128 freed=0 reason=fragmentation
kv_stats: active_prefixes=240 stale_frag_pct=37.2
```

maya: timeline — started as small mem growth, then periodic compaction failed and we saw repeated pagewalks + retries, then oom. No previous sign in metrics until ~30k tokens. :fire_engine:

shiv: ugh. any correlation with kernel-selection changes from last night rollout?

maya: maybe — we switched to new continuous-batching heuristics (batcher v2) + the kernel fallback that pins 2x kv buffers for GPU0. I added a perf flame but need help interpreting.

eli: can you dump per-slab occupancy and fragmentation by prefix? also suspect reuse path isn't hitting because of prefix mismatch.

maya: attaching quick grep output (summarized):
```
prefix:a/occupancy=1.2MB/slots=12/frag=18%
prefix:b/occupancy=24MB/slots=320/frag=52%
prefix:chat-long-usr/occupancy=1.4GB/slots=12800/frag=64%
```

jordan: that chat-long-usr spike looks like sticky allocation. we saw similar when kv hit high reuse churn with long ctx. maybe free lists not returning due to pinned KV windows.

shiv: propose immediate mitigation: 1) enable aggressive eviction for prefixes >500MB 2) enable compact-on-evict for slab 5 3) fallback to truncated-kv model variant (kv-trunc-1) when free<20%

eli: agree. also add a short-term guard that rejects requests if predicted token growth > 50k based on rl-agent heuristics.

maya: testing quick guard now:
```
# config snippet
kv.eviction.threshold_mb=500
kv.compact_on_evict=true
kv.fallback_variant=kv-trunc-1
request.prediction.max_tokens=50000
```

infra-bot: deploy triggered: enable-kv-safety-20260318 by maya — rolling to prod-3 canary

maya: canary applied to 10% nodes, monitoring token/cpu/mem. initial canary shows mem plateau and no thrash for 12 minutes.

jordan: good. we should also add telemetry: sample last-evict-causes and track fragment_pct over time per-prefix + add alert if fragment_pct increase >10% in 5m.

shiv: long term: investigate compaction algorithm — current compactor is O(n) and stalls during high-slot counts. maybe adopt streaming compaction + epoched free lists. also revisit kernel selection rollback that increased pinned kv buffers.

eli: and a perf repro plan: synthetic longctx run with prefix churn + disable reuse path to reproduce frag. will run on staging with perf counters.

maya: I've kept the original heap snapshot (prod-3) and saved to s3://redwood-oom-dumps/1769201234-slab-snapshot.bin

jordan: playbook update idea: when eviction fails 3x in 60s, immediately flip to degraded mode: (a) truncate KV to last 32k tokens (b) reduce batching to prioritize latency over throughput (c) route new requests to dedicated pool if available. This should keep app live while we recover.

maya: added that to runbook draft. will push PR for rollout notes. thanks all. :thumbsup:

shiv: follow-ups — eli/jordan, can you run the staging repro and post profiling heatmaps? we'll sync tomorrow 10:30 PT.

eli: on it.

infra-bot: alert suppressed on prod-3 after mitigations applied (incident id: INC-20260318-42)
